[EN] Such impudence...

You thought it was safe to come here by yourselves? I hope you're not thinking of making it out of here alive.
[ES] Tanta insolencia...

¿Pensaban que era seguro venir aquí solos? Espero que no estén pensando en salir vivos de aquí.

[EN] Be gone with you!
[ES] ¡Largo de aquí!
